subject: Let's schedule your interview with Nimbus Data
body_text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to Nimbus Data. We would like to invite you to interview for the Data Platform Engineer role. We would like to schedule a video interview at your earliest convenience.

Location: Remote (US)

Best,
The Nimbus Data Recruiting Team
